newsitem.title: USA: Tricord Systems Inc Q3 loss grows.
newsitem.headline: Tricord Systems Inc Q3 loss grows.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE:'96 Q3 loss includes $1.7 million, or $0.13 a share, charge for an increase in the allowance for doubtful accounts relating to the Chapter 11 filing of a large reseller.
NOTE: '96 Q3 also includes charge of $310,000, or $0.02 a share, charge for the purchase of the assets of Reliable Distributed Information Corp.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: 1996 nine mos includes charge of $1.7 million, or $0.13 a share, for an increase in the allowance for doubtful accounts relating to Chapter 11 filing by a large reseller; charge of $310,000, or $0.02 a share, related to the acquisition of the assets of RDI Corp; and charge of $400,000, or $0.03 a share, for the eventual resolution of a securities class action matter.

1995 nine mos includes charge of $18.1 million, or $1.37 a share, for disposal and write-down of obsolete inventory due to changes in company's business outlook and an increase in the allowance for doubtful accounts and severance, and charge of $630,000 relating to severance for former president and chief executive.
